title: Going back in time in dreams with the monks; Harry Heller says time is an illusion

tellings.quote: Which Harry Heller said to me in my book when I was in with the Monotones, and sure enough, he proved it was an illusion cuz I kept going back in time.

plain: In his dreams, a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says he went to a mountain with a group of monks and kept going back in time. He tells it himself, linking it to a figure named Harry Haller in his book, who told him that time is an illusion, and he says the dreams "proved it was an illusion cuz I kept going back in time."
